XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: During engine start-up, the starter motor remains engaged longer than necessary.
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | IGNITION | STARTING | ENGINE | MOTOR | ACTIVE | POWERED | P1512 | POWERED | POWER SUPPLY | ON | INSERTION |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Steering lock module including ignition switch

  • Fault: During engine start-up, the starter motor remains engaged for too long

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P1512 (Starter circuit relay/wiring)

  • Cause: Faulty ignition switch

• Intervention: Check and, if necessary, replace the steering lock module including the starter switch

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In the case in question, the two starter motor and starter inhibitor relays in the engine compartment fuse box were initially replaced, without resolving the problem.
    It was also noted that removing the start inhibitor relay caused the starter motor to stop turning, indicating that the component was functioning correctly.
    The problem was solved by replacing the steering lock module, including the start switch.
